channel.title: HiRISE: High Resolution Imaging Science Experiment (NASA)
channel.description: Updates from the HiRISE camera onboard the Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter (MRO/NASA). We are based at the University of Arizona in Tucson, Ariz.

item.title: HiPOD: First Light Illuminates Sand Dunes
item.description: The high north latitudes of Mars’ polar terrains are shrouded in darkness for most of the winter. That season brings extensive frost and ice, which fall out of the atmosphere and coat dunes and other surfaces. (NASA/JPL-Caltech/University of Arizona)
